title: My Way (2008 Remastered)
lyrics:
[00:06.00] And now, the end is near
[00:11.36] And so I face the final curtain
[00:18.59] My friend, I'll say it clear
[00:23.87] I'll state my case, of which I'm certain
[00:30.59] I've lived a life that's full
[00:36.44] I traveled each and every highway
[00:43.20] And more, much more than this
[00:48.71] I did it my way
[00:56.39] Regrets, I've had a few
[01:01.51] But then again, too few to mention
[01:08.62] I did what I had to do
[01:14.30] And saw it through without exemption
[01:21.13] I planned each charted course
[01:26.75] Each careful step along the byway
[01:33.80] And more, much more than this
[01:39.22] I did it my way
[01:45.32] Yes, there were times, I'm sure you knew
[01:51.65] When I bit off more than I could chew
[01:58.22] But through it all, when there was doubt
[02:04.66] I ate it up and spit it out
[02:10.90] I faced it all, and I stood tall
[02:17.29] And did it my way
[02:24.05] I've loved, I've laughed and cried
[02:29.88] I've had my fill, my share of losing
[02:36.89] And now, as tears subside
[02:42.65] I find it all so amusing
[02:48.94] To think I did all that
[02:54.94] And may I say, not in a shy way
[03:01.84] Oh, no, oh, no, not me
[03:07.54] I did it my way
[03:13.68] For what is a man, what has he got?
[03:20.14] If not himself, then he has naught
[03:26.21] To say the things he truly feels
[03:33.37] And not the words of one who kneels
[03:39.72] The record shows I took the blows
[03:46.72] And did it my way
[04:01.30] 
[04:13.34] Yes, it was my way
[04:24.86]
